rows.name: Cold atomic clouds
rows.note: Heiles & Troland 2005: median field 6 uG in cold HI; N_H 1e20-1e21 cm^-2

rows.name: Molecular clouds
rows.note: Crutcher & Kemball 2019: N_H >~ 1e22 cm^-2, B ~ 10 uG (n/300)^0.65; on average 2-3 times supercritical

rows.name: Galactic disc near the Sun
rows.note: Field ~6 uG (Entry 16); gas 13.7 Msun/pc^2 (McKee et al. 2015); all mass within 1.1 kpc of the plane 68 +- 4 (Bovy & Rix 2013)

rows.name: Starburst centres
rows.note: Beck 2015: 50-100 uG in central starbursts; Kennicutt 1998: starburst gas 1e3-1e4 Msun/pc^2 (stars add more)

rows.name: Milky Way halo, out to 100 kpc
rows.note: Halo field 0.73 uG (Entry 16); mass within ~100 kpc 2.75e11 (Jiao et al. 2023) to 5.4e11 Msun (Wang et al. 2022)

rows.name: Rich cluster (Coma)
rows.note: Bonafede et al. 2010: 4.7 uG at the centre, falling outward; Kubo et al. 2007: M200 = 1.88e15/h Msun inside 1.99/h Mpc; gas 10-16% of the mass

rows.name: Cosmic-web filaments
rows.note: Fields 11-15 nG (Carretti et al. 2025) to 30-60 nG (Vernstrom et al. 2021); 1.6e13 Msun in 7.1 x 2.5 /h Mpc (Epps & Hudson 2017); baryons 15.7% of it

peratt.name: Peratt-type galaxy filament
peratt.note: Peratt, Peter & Snell 1990: filaments ~35 kpc wide with ~100 uG fields; a galaxy of 1e11 Msun (range 3e10-3e11) across that width
